query: probability a branded gout drug is reimbursed on the public formulary in Brazil

results.title: CONITEC incorporation decisions for gout therapies
results.content: Access to novel urate-lowering therapies remains limited. Historically, only about 45% of branded gout drugs submitted to CONITEC have been recommended for reimbursement in the public SUS formulary. The typical interval from ANVISA approval to public listing is roughly 2 years.

results.title: Gout epidemiology in Latin America
results.content: The prevalence of gout in the adult Brazilian population is estimated at 2,600 per 100,000. Diagnosis remains a challenge: fewer than 50% of cases are formally diagnosed, and of those diagnosed only around 40% receive appropriate urate-lowering drug therapy.

results.title: Pharma launch economics in emerging markets
results.content: A typical product launch and market-access investment in Brazil runs to about $3.5 million over the first two years, driven by KOL engagement and payer dossiers.
